task: Existing TemporalInquiryLab finite2, task_index=1. The instrument remains fixed; only response_seed changes, then returns to its original value.
source: One live LLM source per apparatus, learned once from three paid control trajectories. Fork only its actual independently confirmed predictor and required files. No supplied law, offline source fit or researcher-selected source predictor.
intervention: Each branch continues through a response change and then its return. retained keeps every confirmed candidate; latest_only keeps only its most recently confirmed candidate. A target inherits its own branch's preceding confirmed state, rather than resetting to the original source. Equal model, tools, limits, evidence prefix and confirmation seeds. The chooser receives generic candidate IDs, never private phase, response seed or mechanism-change labels.
controller: The host only purchases the common three-trajectory prefix and carries confirmed archives between episodes. Every research, fitting, comparison and finish action is selected by agent.run. Ordinary fit callbacks retain their actual original training files when archived; no host coefficient edit or fit=None substitution.
archive_publication: New predictors retain ordinary code, data and binary dependencies. Imported confirmed-model archives accompany them only when declared in the successful finish.reused_files. Runner logs and the undeclared candidate catalog are excluded. An unchanged directly submitted archive keeps its existing dependencies. Revisions to an inherited model publish a new candidate. A latest predictor explicitly depending on an older candidate retains that dependency, which is reported.
failure_policy: No replacement or automatic retry. A source without confirmed submission skips all four dependent target episodes. A failed target publishes no new candidate; the next target keeps that branch's last confirmed state. Keep service failures separate from research failure and compare complete service-available pairs separately.
accounting: Report source costs separately and charge the common source once in each counterfactual condition. Distinguish actual source-plus-target model calls from these counterfactual totals. Host scoring units are not FLOPs; preserve Python execution, archive import/export time, and total episode wall time separately.
terminal_order: Every source and target stops learning before any 128-row terminal evaluation. Source admission uses fresh confirmation only, never terminal outcomes.
scope: Two new parameter realizations within the existing finite-history family. This is a small live decision experiment, not an independent population estimate. Both conditions retain the same powerful shared tools. Explicit candidate execution is observable; an untracked conceptual influence is not inferred from file availability.
model_identity: gpt-6-luna is requested through the existing subscription provider. Usage metadata repeating that name does not independently establish server routing.
